exposure: transforming growth factor beta1 (TGF-beta1) mRNA levels
cohort: The study included 26 women with placenta accreta (cases) and 31 women without placenta accreta (controls).
finding: The study found significant increases in MMP-2, GPx-1 mRNA, SOD, and GSH levels, and decreases in E-CAD, beta-catenin, and TGF-beta1 mRNA in placenta accreta cases compared to controls, suggesting a role for cell-cell adhesion loss and increased antioxidants in PA.
cross-section timing: At the time of placental delivery/diagnosis of placenta accreta
